text:
I went in for a small cavity. They took many photos and the doctor said clearly that it was an easy case and nothing to worry about.

After working in my mouth for almost an hour, the doctor suddenly stopped and told me:
“I’m sorry, you need to go to the hospital. I went too deep and I can’t fix it anymore.”
He placed a temporary filling and sent me away.

A few minutes later, they even called my wife claiming that it was my fault and that I hadn’t taken care of my tooth — completely untrue. They told me I needed root canal removal and a minor operation, with a cost of nearly 40,000 THB. Of course, we refused.

I went directly to the International Hospital in Pattaya.
There, the dentist took one X-ray and fixed the issue right away — no root canal removal, no unnecessary procedures, none of the nonsense I was told before.

The worst part?
They damaged my tooth and still made me pay for the visit.

I will never return.
Very unprofessional doctor and extremely poor after-service.
My tooth was properly fixed only at the International Hospital in Pattaya..
